settings.editor: Confidential consultation process

settings.title: A trusted path to independent medical review

settings.editor: A premium consultation service designed to connect clients with an independent doctor for a personalized medical suitability assessment. Onyx manages booking and coordination, while all medical opinions and decisions remain solely with the independent doctor.

Independent Doctor Consultation is a booking service for clients who want an independent medical suitability review before making advanced wellness, performance, body composition or longevity decisions.
The consultation fee is From 800 AED, paid directly to Onyx for booking and coordination.
Onyx does not diagnose, prescribe, treat, approve, or guarantee product access, prescription, treatment access, or results.

settings.title: A simple and transparent consultation process

settings.editor: From booking to medical review, Onyx coordinates the consultation journey while the independent doctor remains fully responsible for the medical assessment and opinion.
Pay the From 800 AED consultation fee directly through Onyx.
Onyx coordinates the appointment with the independent doctor.
The doctor reviews health background, medications, contraindications, risk factors and objectives.
The doctor may provide general guidance, request lab work, recommend in-person care, or decline suitability.
The consultation does not guarantee approval, prescription, treatment, product access, or results.
Learn more about the licensed doctor conducting the independent medical suitability review.
Dermatologist & Integrative Medicine Specialist

With over 20 years of experience, Dr. Joanna combines classical dermatology with advanced anti-age medicine, personalized nutrition, bioresonance diagnostics, peptide therapy, intravenous drips and stem cell protocols. She takes a limited number of patients and personally guides each one from thorough diagnostics to long-term results. Consultations are available in Dubai and online.
Her role is limited to independent medical suitability review. Onyx does not influence the doctor's medical opinion.
During the independent consultation, the doctor may review various aspects of your health profile to support an informed medical suitability assessment.

settings.editor: Whether in-person medical care is recommended
Please review the information below to understand the roles of Onyx and the independent doctor, the consultation process, and how medical decisions are made.
The consultation is performed independently by the doctor. Onyx is not a medical clinic and does not provide medical diagnosis, prescription, or treatment.
The From 800 AED consultation fee is paid directly to Onyx for booking and coordination of the independent consultation.
The consultation does not guarantee medical approval, prescription, treatment access, product access, or results.
Any medical opinion or decision is made solely by the doctor based on the client's individual profile.
Is Onyx a medical clinic?
No. Onyx is not a medical clinic. Onyx books and coordinates the consultation; the medical review is performed independently by a licensed doctor.
Does the consultation guarantee approval?
No. The consultation does not guarantee approval, treatment access, product access, or any particular result.
Does this guarantee a prescription?
No. Any medical opinion or decision is made solely by the independent doctor, based on your individual profile.
Who receives the From 800 AED payment?
The From 800 AED fee is paid to Onyx for booking and coordination of the independent consultation.
